message:
The other day, I was trying to call my grandson to remind him about our family dinner. Just as I dialed, my phone decided it was the perfect time to die—no warning, no chance to plug it in. I laughed to myself, thinking about how much I rely on technology for everything these days. 

It got me thinking about how important it is to have a backup plan, whether that’s having a physical map on hand or keeping important documents in a designated spot. Sometimes, the simplest preparations can save us a bit of stress when things go sideways. 

What little things do you do to stay ready for the unexpected?
